final.answer:
The IT Asset Policy says engineering staff at level **L4 and above** are allocated a **MacBook Pro 16-inch M4 Max with 36GB RAM and 1TB SSD**. By contrast, engineering staff at **L1–L3** receive a **MacBook Pro 14-inch M4 Pro with 18GB RAM and 512GB SSD**, or an equivalent ThinkPad with Ubuntu 24.04. [TechNova_IT_Asset_Policy.pdf::sec1]

If by “senior engineering staff” you mean **Senior Software Engineer (L3)**, the salary structure maps that title to **L3**, which would place them in the **L1–L3 engineering allocation**, not the L4+ allocation. [TechNova_Salary_Structure.pdf::sec1] [TechNova_IT_Asset_Policy.pdf::sec1]

So:
- **Senior Software Engineer (L3):** MacBook Pro 14-inch M4 Pro / equivalent ThinkPad [TechNova_Salary_Structure.pdf::sec1] [TechNova_IT_Asset_Policy.pdf::sec1]
- **Lead Engineer / Manager and above (L4+):** MacBook Pro 16-inch M4 Max [TechNova_Salary_Structure.pdf::sec1] [TechNova_IT_Asset_Policy.pdf::sec1]
